MATH DEFECT REPORTED, NOT FIXED (math-adjacent, per skill: report never fix inline). The token '\\mathcal{L}_\\xid\\alpha' appears twice - once in the align block (third term) and once in the prose sentence about [d, L_xi] = 0. The intended reading is L_xi (d alpha), but '\\xid' is a REAL macro: main.tex:222 defines \\newcommand{\\xid}{{\\xi_{d}}} ('Reeb field (d-component)'). So the PDF silently typesets L_{xi_d} alpha instead of L_xi d alpha, turning the key cancellation sentence into 'Theta wedge L_{xi_d} alpha = Theta wedge d L_xi alpha', which is not what [d, L_xi] = 0 gives. On the KaTeX/markdown render path \\xid is not defined at all, so the same two spots error out. These are the only two occurrences of \\xid in all of content/. PROPOSED FIX: insert a space - '\\mathcal{L}_\\xi d\\alpha' in both places.
